independent_method: Read existing audited data only. Verify report/source/worker output hashes; compare every candidate row to its complete selected source and physical GPU; independently enumerate all 2^20 integer subsets using per-shape acceptable-candidate requirements at 0/1/2%, compare all minimum subsets and ranks; recompute selected medians, metrics, usage, and relative config paths.
findings: Within 20 declared generic candidates, 1% requires exactly 8 generic candidates plus old5; there are 2 minimum feasible subsets and the selected ranking is correct.
291/295 strict external median wins; all 4 losses are current v7 K384/N7168 shapes, each with 0/3 paired-round wins.
178 complete v6 shape records and 117 complete v7 records are used; v7 preserves every refined shape physical GPU/UUID from v6.
Relative to same-source old25_old5, equal-shape geomean latency is +0.1146371738% and worst gap +3.9505712033% at 1152x7168x384.
Original5/9000 sources, shared OPUS helpers, registration and the frozen registered binary pass final protection checks.
limitations: Raw-round numerical validation is inherited from completed upstream audits; this independent review does not run kernels. The selected set is a measured offline portfolio, not a benchmarked production/restricted dispatch. registered_opus_ids remains declarative for the existing loader.
